events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in the oil market and global instability. The US has shown military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalating conflict could lead to increased oil prices, which would negatively impact the oil and gas exploration and production sector. On the other hand, the overall market could see a boost due to safe-haven bids and increased military spending.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for further escalation or de-escalation

events.exitStrategy: Exit when conflict de-escalates or oil prices stabilize
